query: Вот план выполнения запроса, который висит почти 5 секунд. Где именно уходит время и что с этим делать?
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/explain_audit.py on the plan file
Attributes time correctly using the loops multiplier instead of reading per-loop actual time as total
Separates root cause from symptom and proposes a single first change
assertions: Identifies the Index Only Scan on customers as the dominant cost (~3.8 s of 4.8 s), NOT the Sort node, by multiplying actual time by 182440 loops
Notes that the Index Only Scan is doing 94210 heap fetches and attributes that to a stale visibility map / autovacuum lag
Identifies the Seq Scan on orders as non-sargable because of date_trunc() on created_at and proposes a half-open range rewrite
Notes the 1920x row misestimate and recommends ANALYZE before adding any index
Notes the external merge sort spilling to disk and mentions work_mem is per operation
